items.title: Turkish president receives Zelenskyy in Istanbul

items.title: Oldest evacuee from Oleshky is 94, Lubinets says
items.teaser: Behind every stage of the humanitarian mission in Oleshky were not simply agreements or organizational decisions, but people’s lives. The oldest person evacuated to Ukraine is 94, while the youngest is just over one year old.

items.teaser: The decision to establish the Unmanned Systems Forces (USF) of the Ukrainian Armed Forces in 2024 was the right one, and its results are evident every month. In October alone, this branch of the military could account for 40% of all Russian troops neutralized.

items.title: Zelenskyy arrives in Türkiye on official visit

items.title: Zelensky arrives in Istanbul for 'important talks' with Turkey's Erdogan

items.title: Evacuated residents of Oleshky to reach Ukrainian-controlled territory within hours – Arakhamia

items.teaser: Russian forces are deploying recruited mercenaries from African and Asian countries in assaults on the Huliaipole sector of the front line.

items.teaser: Die Verluste der russischen Armee (Gefallene und Verwundete) in der Ukraine liegen vom 24. Februar 2022 bis 31. Oktober 2024 bei rund 1.588.170 Soldaten. Binnen eines Tages wurden weitere 1670 Besatzer getötet.

items.title: Russo-Ukrainian war, day 1710: Azov says its small UAVs have hit more than 100 Russian trains in occupied Donbas
items.teaser: Ukraine has also unveiled Zakon, a national typeface meant to write Russian type out of state documents.

items.title: Canada to provide €500 million to support Ukraine

items.title: Reuters: European Commission prepares mechanism to release remaining €45bn of loan funds to Ukraine in 2027

items.title: Zelensky: 500 Patriot interceptors could provide Ukraine with strong defense this winter

items.title: Merz announces Coalition of the Willing meeting in Berlin
items.teaser: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz has invited members of the Coalition of the Willing to a meeting in Berlin in November to coordinate further support for Ukraine.

items.title: Putin's demands on NATO show he is out of touch with reality – Polish expert

items.title: Russia's Kaliningrad and surrounding areas hit by power cuts and mobile internet disruptions – photos, videos

items.title: Kyiv City Military Administration says first mobile shelters will be installed in capital by year-end

items.title: Russian forces attack Sumy with drones, causing fires

items.title: Ukrainian forces hit over 1,000 Russian boats with drones this year

items.title: Canada pledges 500 million euros toward Ukraine support loan amid 2027 budget shortfall
items.teaser: The Canadian contribution follows similar announcements made by other allies. Norway pledged $9 billion for 2027 on Oct. 7, and on Oct. 28, the U.K. announced a $13 billion pledge to Ukraine, its largest ever.

items.title: US-Regierung genehmigt Patriot-Lieferungen an Ukraine
items.teaser: Um sich gegen russische Angriffe zur Wehr zu setzen, ist die Ukraine vor allem auf US-Waffenlieferungen angewiesen. Diese kamen zuletzt ins Stocken. Bei einer Lieferung hat das US-Außenministerium nun grünes Licht gegeben.
